title: craftframe
summary: MSUI implements the Craft window through its shared profession panel: ProfessionPanelOpenerLaw forks effect-47 openers into TradeSkill vs Craft by EffectMiscValue (exactly the reference law), Program.UiPanelOwnership registers 'BenillaCraftFrame' in the left panel area, and DrawProfessionFrame renders the 384x512 four-quadrant shell with skill name + value/max, an 8-row difficulty-colored recipe list with wheel scroll, product icon/name, reagent grid with have/need counts, tool and spell-focus requirement lines, and Create / Create All / Exit-Cancel buttons with batch casting.

openItems.text: No rank StatusBar (BenillaCraftRankFrame) - skill shown as plain 'value / max' text, no bar fill
No scrollbar widget on the recipe list (Benilla ships the faux-scroll kit with up/down buttons; MSUI is mouse-wheel only)
No expand/collapse header row or CollapseAll button (Benilla ships them, engine no-op; MSUI omits entirely)
No craft description/subtext lines (BenillaCraftDescription, $parentSubText) in the detail pane
